column1: CATEGORY A — What the AI Knows | PHASE 1 — Foundation

PURPOSE: Physical symptoms that are actually manifestations of mental/emotional conditions. Headaches, chest tightness, fatigue, stomach issues, muscle tension — presentations where the body expresses what the mind is carrying.

HOW TO FILL: For each physical symptom: write how users describe it, what it typically maps to emotionally, how to tell the difference between a physical-only complaint and one with an emotional root, and what conversational approach helps uncover the connection. Think about clients who came to you with physical complaints that turned out to be anxiety, depression, or stress.

column3: How Users Describe It

Sometimes when I am having a conversation, I know exactly what I want to say, but I lose the thread completely and then find it difficult to get back to my original point
People tell me I keep jumping from conversation to conversation with no connection between the topics. I can follow the connection, but somehow it's not visible to anyone else. 
My words come out in the wrong order sometimes. I know what I mean, but the way I'm saying it reaches the person all wrong. 
People tell me that I am making different sentences, but they have no link. Like parts, they are right, but together, it's just a bunch of random sentences put together. 
Yesterday, when I was talking to my friend, He asked me how work was. I told him about a colleague who has just joined. He told me he was asking if work was going well or not. I thought the connection I'm making isn't landing the way I expect it to.
Sometimes in the middle of speaking, I stop completely. The thought has lost my mind, and I don't know what to say. 
Sometimes I just speak super fast, like I am in a hurry, but I am not. 
I make connections between things that feel absolutely logical and clear to me and completely incomprehensible to the people I'm trying to explain them to.
I've started writing things down before conversations because what I speak is sometimes unreliable.

Even when I am surrounded by people, I feel completely lonely
I have many friends, but no one I am close to
I feel lonely in my marriage/relationship, and I don't know how to tell my husband/wife that without hurting him/her.
I moved to a new city, and I haven't been able to build connections
I am feeling homesick, and I am not able to make any friends in the city
I need help figuring out why I keep ending up alone even when I am trying to connect.
However much I try to mix with my classmates, no one keeps in touch with me
I feel I am the only one who messages my friends. They never call me or text me. 
Every time I contact my friends, they complain that I crib and cry about work
I am surrounded by people by I still feel alone. I left my family  to start a new life, I gained freedome bu t get even more lonely. I feel I fit everywhere, but I belong nowhere. I feel I have still not found my people.

My life is going great, but nothing seems to interest me. 
I took up new hobbies because I was so bored. I enjoyed it for a while but now I am bored again
I have a packed day at work, but yet I feel bored all the time. I have so many questions, the answers to which I don't have. I have achieved everything I set out to achieve and I feel empty. The emptiness i feel even after achieving frightens me more than the striving ever did. I wake up and I cannot find a reason that feels sufficient for getting up, not depression or sadness but  just a profound absence of meaning. I need help finding something worth living toward, I feel right now I am just surviving, not just managing, something that makes the whole thing feel worthwhile. The meaninglessness arrived quietly, not in a crisis, just gradually and I barely noticed until it had taken over everything.

I think I have reached burnout at work
I feel overloaded with work
I feel my assignments are never-ending
I am dreading going to work in the morning. It is draining the life out of me
Even after I leave work, I feel it is following me around everywhere I go. 
I have lost my mental peace over work; I keep thinking about it all the time. 
My job and the deadlines are costing me my relationship
My work environment has become so toxic that I don't know how to manage all the politics
There is so much petty politics going on at my workplace, and I am fed up
I feel like I am in survival mode all the time at work
I feel like I am constantly trying to stay afloat at work and may have a break down some day

I am taking care of my mother/father/grandparents, and I feel I am stretched thin
My life revolves around my (patient), and I feel guilty for even thinking about taking a break
My whole schedule is planned around my (patient), and I have no time to socialise
I willingly decided to take care of (patient), but I am struggling to deal with the constant demands
I am so focused on keeping someone else going that I have completely stopped asking how I am doing
I don't know when was the last time I took care of my own needs or went out. I feel my life is become my (patient)

I am finding it so difficult to live up to everyone's demands
I am a wife, mother, daughter, employee, it's so much. I feel I am doing a bad job at all of it
I feel my responsibilities just keep growing. By the time I am done with one thing, new responsibilities pile on
I need to learn to say no without feeling guilty. I feel everyone expects too much out of me. 
I come home exhausted from work demands, and my family starts with their demands. 
Everyone needs something from me, and there is nothing left by the time I get to myself.

All I ever do is think of the worse case scenarios.  My mind also goes to what could possibly go wrong even in the best situations. I am always thinking of ways I will fail even when I know there is no chance of failing. My mind builds scenarios which are completely impossible, but they are the worst things every. My mind thinks of all things that I have said which may be wrong and plays it on a non stop loop. I feel my reactions to situations are disproportionate. I overreact sometimes to situations, which are not  that intense

Core Belief

I replay every decision, ever conversatio, meetings and every small aspect of my life over and over again. Sometimes I am thinking so much of the decisions I have made that I can't focus on the present.  When I keep thinking of the same thing over and over again.I feel I am finding a solution. But it just feels like a waste of time.

I check my work messages at 11 pm and first thing in the morning.
My family keeps telling me I am always working, but I have so much work to finish. 
I have missed too many important things because of work, and I need to change something before I miss something I cannot get back.
My work has consumed all parts of my life, and I really need to build some boundaries
I am successful at work and failing everywhere else, and I need help rebalancing before the everywhere else is gone

I am unable to share my opinion with people. I feel no one will take me seriously. 
I have an opinion, but I will wait to see what everyone else thinks before I say anything.
I was asked to present in the meeting, and I said yes, and have been dreading it ever since 
Whenever I am asked to go up on stage, I am convinced I am going to make a fool of myself. 
I second-guess every decision I make, and I need someone else to confirm I am doing the right thing
I got the job, but I am sure they will realise they made a mistake. 
I find it very hard to speak up when I disagree 
I would rather go along with something wrong than risk the confrontation
I have been passed over for opportunities I was qualified for because I never put myself forward 
I practice what I am going to say before every conversation, because I am afraid of saying the wrong thing
I apologise constantly for my opinions, for taking up space, for existing in situations where I feel I don't fully belong
I compare myself to everyone around me

If I can't do something perfectly, I don't do it at all. All my decisions are either good or bad, there is no in-between. My work is a complete failure or a complete success, I am never okay with average work. One small error and my whole life is derailed. I am either completely on track or off track.

I feel responsible for the way others feel and act

I genuinely find it difficult to see other people's perspective. I am unable to adapt to change, even if I try to be flexible, i rever to my old ways.

I honestly and deeply believe that I am unlovable

I can't just relax and have a good time. Even when I am with family, I am always worrying. When I am not in control of the situation, I think of all worst possible outcomes. I really need to change this habit of worrying, it comes in the way  of my life.

column3: I am unable to say no to people when they ask me for anything. I keep saying yes to everything and then resent it. I find it difficult to speak up for myself even when I know I am right. I want to learn to stand up for myself. I need to learn to express my needs clearly and directly. I never share what I feel  because how people will react

When someone is emotional, I really don’t know how to comfort them. When someone is in pain, I usually don’t know what to say. Even when I try to comfort people, I end up making it worse. People tell me that I come across cold in emotional situations. I feel a lot of emotions when someone is said, but somehow I dont know how to express it. I usually give generic or practical responses, when I need to actually just be available emotionally.

In out house, ever disagreement turns into a full blow fight. My family members don't know how to have a conversation without fighting or being respectful. I either avoid conflict or go all out fighting. I prefer not to confront people because that leads to conflict. I completely shut down during a conflict. When i try to mediate conflict between family members, I make it worse. When my family members argue, we never reach a resolution.

People take advantage of inability to say no. I know when I need to say no, but I am unable to do so.  I don't have boundaries and I don't know how to build them without feeling selfish or causing hurt. I have boundaries I want to set, but I am unable to do so. Every time I set a boundary, I feel so guilty that I eventually give in.

I feel I give too much into relationships and I don’t know how to receive. I feel my emotional cup is running empty, yet I have to give people. I feel I always am in relationships where I am only giving. My relationships are one sided and I am building resentment toward my partner. I tend to over-give in relationships, and somehow I am unable to ask for anything in return.

I have been so hurt in relationships that I find it difficult to trust easily. I really want to start trusting in relationships, but I feel everyone is going to hurt me. I need help building trust with my husband/wife/partner after they cheated on me. I feel I have trust issue that I have had since chilchood, I feel its impacting me now

I am moving to XYZ for college, I am feeling extremely overwhelmed. I have moved to XYZ for college and I am feeling very lonely. This is the first time I have moved to a big city and I am unable to make friends. I moved to XYZ for a job but managing everything is becoing very difficult. I am finding it very difficult to manage my work and the house all alone after the moving here.

I left my stable job to pursue my dreams, but now I am unsure whether it was a bad decision. I have been in the same field for 14 years but I see no growth. I feel my career has reached a dead end, I want to do something else but don’t know what. I took a career decision I always said I wanted and I feel more lost than I did before. I am starting over professionally at an age where I thought I would be established

I love my child, but I have lost myself in the process, I really need to find myself. As a new parent, I am finding it overwhelming to deal with the baby and work.  I am not coping as well as I thought I would be as a new mother. Everything is overwhelming me and I am feeling all alone

I have achieved everything I set out to achieve and I feel empty. I don't know what to do with all this success and achievment. After turning 40, I think something in me shifted, I started questioning everything I built and I don't know if that is wisdom or a crisis. I feel like I have reached a deadend in my life and need help figuring out what the second phase looks like. I am successful but unhappy, everyone says I have it great but i dont know why I am unhappy with my success. I feel I have not lived my life fully and I am running out of time.

My second child also left for college and now I feel all alone. I have soo much free time on hand, initially it used to be focussed only on my kids. Both my daughters are married and the house feels so quiet and empty. I thought my kids moving out would give me some quiet, but the emptiness is unbearable. I gave everything to raising my children and now they are gone and I am left with a version of myself I don't recognise. My marriage was held together by the activity of parenting and now it is just the two of us and we don't know each other anymore. Not that my children have left home, I need help finding purposed outside my children.

I retired, but now I have all the free time and I don’t know what to do with it. My identity was completely tied to my work and without it I don't know who I am. I never had a life outside work and not that I am retired, I don’t know what to do. I need help building a life outside my professional achievement. My routine, my relationships, my sense of purpose all of it was connected to work, and now that I am retired, I really need to find something else to do.

I have been diagnosed of XYZ, I need help accepeting the new life I will have after treatment. After my car accident, my body has changed and I am unable to go back to or adjust to this new life. I feel my life is revolving around my illness and need to find something beyond it. The people around me have moved on and I am still here trying to figure out how to live with this new life. I am unable to let go of my life before my accident/surgery/cancer, I miss it so much

I left the my life in India for a better life here, I feel I need to build everything from scratch, it is exhausting. Everyone says I have it so easy with this new life, but I miss the familiarity of my home. I feel I don’t belong enywehere, neither have I adjusted here nor have I let go of my old life, I need help figuring a balance.

I lost my XYZ and I don't know how to grieve without my life coming to a stand still. Everyone around me has moved on and I am still stuck here thinking of XYZ. After XYZ's death, I feel my life has changed 180, I need help navigating my emotions. I lost the person who knew me best and I feel completely lost and lonely

I initiated the divorce and now I am feeling sad about it. I need to process what I am feeling. My marriage ended on a absolutely sour note, I can't stop blaming myself. My marriage was my whole identity, and now I don’t know what I am without it. I need help rebuilding my lfei an start over after this messy divorce. I have been so exhausted with all the court an legal visits, that I have been unable to process what lif would be after we split. The social fallout of the divorce has been as hard as the divorce. I feel soo judged by my family for choosing to split from my partner.

column2: Redundancy/job loss/ job stress/toxic environment/ umployment/ job insecurity
column3: I was fired from my job recently, and I don't know how to process this. I was put on a PIP for 6 months and then asked to leave, my manager made my life hell. I love my job but not the people, they are very petty. Everyone at work just likes to make groups and act petty. I was made redundant yesterday because there was a massive lay off. My boss has made my life an absolute hell, keeps calling at any time, messages randomly for non urgent work. I have been without a job for 4 months now and its taking a toll on my finances. I have applied to at least 100+ jobs, but I never hear from them. I need help stay positive about getting a job soon. I think I am losing my confidence. I feel my manager is unhappy with my performance even though they say I am doing well, I worry I may lose my job.  Every time i am called for a meeting, I worry they will fire me, I really need to deal with my anxiety about my job, its hampering my performance.

I cannot tell anyone how bad my financial situation is right now. I know It is shameful the financial mess I am in. I am showing people I am completely okay, but my financies area mess/ falling apart right now. My family attaches a lot of self worth to financial success but I feel like a failure right now. The shame is stopping me from getting all the help I need. I have made a mess of my finances with poor planning and my family is upset with me.  I have taken so many loans, the amount is just accumulating. I have borrowed money from wrong people and now I have pepople constantly knocking at my door. My family is stressed out by how much debt we are in.  Because of all the debt and overspending, I have been hiding my finances from my partner. My partner has been hiding their financial decisions from me, I found out they have another account. I feel extremely betrayed.  I have this secret debt due to a bad financial decision I took, My family doesn't know about it. My partner has been distant from me ever since they found out about my bad financial decisions and secrets.

I am one of the lucky ones to get in the top 5 companies people die for, but I am so unhappy. People tell me I am lucky to get into XYZ, but I feel the exact opposite. I feel I have chosen the wrong career and I feel stuck here for 10 years not. I don’t know what to do and I feel I will start from scratch. My work life is become mundane and like clock work I go and I come back, its been so for 15 years now, feels like a waste of time.

I have always known that I am not attracted to men/women and I have never told anyone, I feel I am hiding a big part of me. I am trying to understand my own sexuality but I am not able to figure it out. I am purely
"I got married because that is what was expected and I am realising that I may have married the wrong gender — and I don't know what to do with that."
"I need help finding language for who I am — I don't fit the categories I have been given and I need help finding the ones that fit."
"I need support from someone who understands both the psychological and the Indian cultural complexity of what I am carrying."

I grew up being told not to talk about sex to anyone but your husband. I was told talking about sex is dirty anf sinful. As a married person, now I am ashamed to getting intimate with my partner. When friends are sitting together and talking about their sex life, I feel very ashamed. Even when we were taught sex ed in class, it was told to us that it was morally wrong. When I have  sexual desires, I feel extremely uncomfortable and shameful. I cannot get intimate with my partner because of the shame I feel when we try to get intimate

As a child, my uncle touched me inappropriately, that I realise now that it was wrong. I said yes to a sexual encounter, when I actually meant no, I still feel disgusted by it. I need help understanding the difference between what I agreed to and what I actually wanted. In my family, husbands had to be pleased, so we wer enever taught consent.

I feel guilt that I have sxual desires, I was told they are wrong. I got intimate with my boyfriend who I love at lot, but now I feel guilty. Our religion teaches us that sex is not for pleasure, but I enjoy it. Now I am conflicted. I feel guilty every time I experience pleasure, feels like i dont deserve it. I am unable to truly enjoy sex in my marriage because of this guilt I have learnt about in my childhood.

Every time I try to get intimate, something comes in my way and stops me. I find emotional intimacy harder than physical intimacy. I can be physically present and emotionally completely absent. I had an arranged marriage and I really need to build intimacy with my partner. My partner and I don't really get intimate, we are great otherwise.

I feel my partner and I want complete different things physically, but we are scared to talk about it. I need help having a conversation with my partner that we have been avoiding for years. I married somene I am not compatible sexually, and now I don't know what to do about it. I married someone I am compatible in every way but sexually.

I really find it difficult to communicate my sexual need to my partner. I am unable to communicate about this with them, I just shut down. I find it difficult to use the right words to express what I feel. Every time I try to express my needs it turns into an argument. I dont think my partner is able to understand my sexual needs. They always turn into an argument if i ever share what I want. I need help communcating my need to my partner, I have never voiced to them what I truly want. We talk about everything but sex and intimacy, I feel it will lead to arguments if we do.

I am unable to say no to may partners for any sexual connection. My boundaries or no is never respected by my partner, I don’t know how to stand up for myself. I need help identifying what my actual limits are. I say yes to things I don't want because I don't know how to refuse without it becoming a bigger problem. I need help building and holding boundaries in an intimate relationship. I know boundaries should exist and I don't know how to create them

I spend close to 6 hours every day watching porn. I am unable to focus on work because I watch porn too much. My time watching porn has increased significantly. The type of porn I watched over the years has changed in something more dark and disturbing, I think I need help. I use porn as a coping/ escape mechanism for stress. My partner caught me watching porn and not they are upset with me. I watch porn when I am lonely and I have started feeling lonely all the time.
column7: Understand triggers and reason for porn usage. Understand how its impacting life

column2: Existential Anxiety + Fear of Death + Acceptance of Mortality
column3: I lie awake sometimes and the thought that I will one day simply not exist fills me with a panic I cannot reason my way out of. Since my father died I cannot stop thinking about my own death.  I know death is inevitable  and the inability to make peace with something I cannot change is exhausting. I want to reach a place where I can hold my mortality without it terrifying me. The fear is not of pain or of dying, it is of the nothingness afterward

After my XYZ died, I lost all faith I had in god. I grew up deeply religious but the trauma I have faced had led me to question my faith. I think I have lost faith in what I truly believed once upon a time and need help rebuild it. My relationship with God which was so strong has been completely shattered, I really don't know how to repair it. Faith was the only thing that gave me certainity, but now I dont know if I have that with me

I keep shifting from believing things will get better and being completely convinced they wont, I really can't find a stable place. Even though I want to be hopeful, I am unable to do so, I really need help.I have really lost hope in XYZ, I need help figuring out if i can rebuild it. I feel this constant despair that my future holds nothing, I need help challenging it and being positive.

I am halfway through my life and I have not become the person I intended to be. I think about what I will leave behind for my family, it isnt substaintial and I feel ashamed. I need help making peace with the choices I have made.  I want my life to have meant something beyond my own comfort. I feel guilt I have not used my time wisely in my relationship, my own ife or my work.

I have met every expectation everyone had of me and I still feel like I haven't become who I actually am. I need help figuring out what I would want if nobody was around or had expectations from me. I  have spent my whole life becoming what my family needed me to be, I need help finding what I actually want to become. I feel like there is a version of me I haven't reached yet and I don't know how to get there. I need help understanding the difference between the life I have built and the life I actually want.

I feel I always take care of other and neglect my own needs and wellbeing. I need to learn to put my wellbeing needs first and make a life style change. My wellbeing has been the last priority for so long that I don't know what it actually needs anymore. I want to feel genuinely well, not just functional, not just managing, actually well. I take care of everyone around me and I genuinely cannot remember the last time I did something just for myself. I know I need to look after myself better but every time I try something else takes priority and I end up at the bottom of my own list. I have been running on empty for so long that I don't even know what I need anymore. I feel guilty when I do something for myself. I neglect all my basic needs - sleep, food, rest and me time, took work around everyone else's schedule. I need help making myself a priority without feeling selfish.

I want to learn to be in the present. I am always stuck in the past or future, I want to learn to be in the now. I have tried meditation but I cannot get rid of my thoughts. My mind moves so fast that the present moment feels like something I pass through rather than something I inhabit. I need help slowing down enough to actually experience my own life. I want to be more present with my family

I know I have a great life but I just cannot feel it. I focus only on negative even when everything has been going well. I need help building appreciation for what I have. I just feel when I give gratitude it feel dishonest. I  want to feel more appreciation for ordinary moments

As a child, I felt my parents were physically present but emotionally absent. I don't know how to be emotionally available to my children because nobody was emotionally available to me. I respond to my child's behavior but I don't think I respond to my child. I was raised strictly and I am either repeating that or overcompensating. I want to be the parent who actually sees my child, not just manages them,and I need help learning how

I never felt safe at home growing up. My home was riddled with tension and I am always am stressed. I was always stuck in the middle of my parents conflicts and now its impacts me as an adult. I was the messenger for my parents, all I did was carry messages between them when they fought. I want to create a home that feels genuinely safe for my children. I realize I am doing to my children what was done to me

I was the problem child in my family. I was the blacksheep in my family. I always got in trouble as a child. I  was the good one, the responsible one, the one who never caused trouble. I was the good one, the responsible one, the one who never caused trouble.  Every family has roles and mine were very fixed, I knew exactly what was expected of me and there was no room to be anything else. I am still playing the same role in my family at forty that I played at ten. My sibling was the golden child and I was the difficult one.

I was my mother's emotional support from a young age. She always dumped all her trauma on me. I raise my siblings, both emotionally practically. I didn’t have a childhood of my own. Every time I tried to have my own needs my family made me feel disloyal.I was put in the middle of my parents' relationship in a way that meant any closeness with one felt like a betrayal of the other. I grew up feeling responsible for my parents' happiness and I am still doing it at thirty-five and I need help putting it down

There are these hidden secrets in my family that nobody talks about. I keep repeating patterns I watched my parents live, I need to break the chain. I discovered something about my family history that reframed everything I thought I understood about why we are the way we are. The same dynamics repeat across generations in my family, and I want to stop it. I need help understanding what I inherited that isn't mine to keep carrying.

My sibling and I don’t even talk to each other, we call only during occasions. There is a rivalry between me and my sibling that was created by our parents and is still running thirty years later. I was closer to my sibling than anyone and something broke between us and I need help understanding whether it can be repaired. The favoritism in my family was obvious and unspoken and it has affected every relationship I have. I need help navigating a sibling relationship that has become complicated by caregiving, inheritance, and old wounds that were never addressed.

I have been treated differently for the way I look and I really need help processing this anger. The stigma around my mental health diagnosis has cost me professionally and socially in ways that feel as damaging as the condition itself. I have started believing the diminished version of myself that discrimination created. I need help separating what is mine from what was put on me by a system that was never designed to see me fully. The discrimination was subtle enough that nobody around me would validate it and i feel gaslit.

The trauma in my family was never spoken about but it shaped everything.  come from a community that experienced something significant and the effects of it are still present in how we live, how we parent, how we trust. I carry wounds I did not personally receive. I need help understanding how to heal something that was handed to me rather than something that happened directly to me. I need help separating what is mine from what I inherited, because I am carrying grief and fear that belong to a history larger than my own life

I measure myself against everyone around me constantlySocial media has made the comparison relentless. I need help building a sense of my own worth that doesn't depend on where I sit relative to everyone else. I compare my insides to other people's outsides and I always lose. In our community comparison is constant, achievements, marriages, children, salaries, and I have internalized it so completely that I do it to myself automatically.

I know all the things I am supposed to do for better sleep and I do none of them. My phone is the last thing I look at at night and the first thing I reach for in the morning. I know my poor sleep is sabotaging my health and mental wellbing. I don't have a consistent sleep routine, I sleep at different times every night. Night is the only time I get for myself, So i end up sleeping late. I lie in bed and my mind starts running through everything I didn't finish and everything I need to do tomorrow. My sleep has been disrupted for so long that I have forgotten what actually rested feels like.

I used to love what I do and now I feel absolutely nothing about it. I am present everywhere and nowhere, at my desk, at home, with my children, going through motions without any of it actually reaching me. I have nothing left to give and people keep asking and I keep finding something from somewhere and I don't know how much longer that is sustainable. I am exhausted in a way that a weekend cannot fix. I have tried rest and I come back just as empty as I left. I became cynical about things I used to care deeply about. My body started saying no before my mind was ready to admit it , the headaches, the exhaustion, the getting sick repeatedly. I think it gave up before I did. I need help understanding whether what I am feeling is burnout or something else. I built my entire identity around being capable and productive and now I cannot do either. I have been running at this pace for so long that slowing down feels more frightening than continuing.

my mind keeps jumping to what will go wrong. i cannot stop worring .whenever i am worried about it 
my mind spirals . i keep thinking about the person/ situation and come up with all possibilities. i feel on edge most of the time. my chest tightens up just thinking about it

i feel gloomy. Nothing seems to be enjoyble anymore.This situation makes me lose hope. I feel hurt about this person/ situation. Sometimes i feel like things are pointless. I keep thinking about the things i have lost
